zapisi.pojam_izvornik: This file contains the multilingual list of terms which are part of the terminological entries created by the Court of Justice of the European Union and which belong to multilingual and multi-system collections.
ekvivalenti: This file contains the multilingual list of terms which are part of the terminological entries created by the Court of Justice of the European Union and which belong to multilingual and multi-system collections.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Comparative Multilingual Legal Vocabulary (sheet: Comparative_Legal_Vocabulary) 1443 entries
ekvivalenti: Comparative Multilingual Legal Vocabulary (sheet: Comparative_Legal_Vocabulary) 1443 entries

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Entries in this collection are the most detailed and contain numerous information and references (mainly national), with comparative law notes on the differences between legal systems. They are created in the context of major subject-based projects (Systematic terminology work in 3 subject fields: family law, rights of aliens and criminal law) or in the context of translation of references for a preliminary ruling (punctual terminology work - all subject fields).
ekvivalenti: Entries in this collection are the most detailed and contain numerous information and references (mainly national), with comparative law notes on the differences between legal systems. They are created in the context of major subject-based projects (Systematic terminology work in 3 subject fields: family law, rights of aliens and criminal law) or in the context of translation of references for a preliminary ruling (punctual terminology work - all subject fields).

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Available soon: multilingual list and conceptual trees which facilitate intuitive search, show semantic relations between the concepts and help to avoid confusion.
ekvivalenti: Available soon: multilingual list and conceptual trees which facilitate intuitive search, show semantic relations between the concepts and help to avoid confusion.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Collection “National Courts and Tribunals” (sheet: National_Courts_Tribunals) 309 entries
ekvivalenti: Collection “National Courts and Tribunals” (sheet: National_Courts_Tribunals) 309 entries

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Entries in this collection contain a description in French (will be proposed in English in the future) explaining the main competences of the court  or tribunal concerned; its different name(s) with national references; the French term in the Court’s Vade Mecum (Internal document intended for all those involved in the process of drafting, processing and presenting documents relating to the judicial activity of the courts of the European Union) and, if applicable, notes or definitions.
ekvivalenti: Entries in this collection contain a description in French (will be proposed in English in the future) explaining the main competences of the court  or tribunal concerned; its different name(s) with national references; the French term in the Court’s Vade Mecum (Internal document intended for all those involved in the process of drafting, processing and presenting documents relating to the judicial activity of the courts of the European Union) and, if applicable, notes or definitions.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Collection “CJEU Rules of Procedure” (sheet: Rules_of_procedure) 457 entries
ekvivalenti: Collection “CJEU Rules of Procedure” (sheet: Rules_of_procedure) 457 entries

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Entries in this subject-based collection contain terms in all the languages with references to the rules of procedure of the two Courts, contexts, notes and sometimes definitions in French.
ekvivalenti: Entries in this subject-based collection contain terms in all the languages with references to the rules of procedure of the two Courts, contexts, notes and sometimes definitions in French.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Collection "National Legal Acts" (sheet: National Legal Acts) 34 entries
ekvivalenti: Collection "National Legal Acts" (sheet: National Legal Acts) 34 entries

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Entries in this collection contain the legal acts of each legal system, as found in national legislation. They include a description of the concept in French (the English description will be added in the future), a national reference and a reference to a CJEU document, preferably a judgment of the Court, a definition and an explanatory note. The ‘origin’ field provides information on the legal system of origin.
ekvivalenti: Entries in this collection contain the legal acts of each legal system, as found in national legislation. They include a description of the concept in French (the English description will be added in the future), a national reference and a reference to a CJEU document, preferably a judgment of the Court, a definition and an explanatory note. The ‘origin’ field provides information on the legal system of origin.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: 2-Instructions for understanding and manipulating the file:
ekvivalenti: 2-Instructions for understanding and manipulating the file:

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: The tables are sorted in ascending order of IATE entry numbers (1st column).
ekvivalenti: The tables are sorted in ascending order of IATE entry numbers (1st column).

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Rows coloured in orange: when the entry or the term is not visible to the public, therefore only accessible for interinstitutional users (column Open to the public?: NO).
ekvivalenti: Rows coloured in orange: when the entry or the term is not visible to the public, therefore only accessible for interinstitutional users (column Open to the public?: NO).

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Column "LG": LG corresponds to the language in which an entry is completed. There is one line per term, even when there are several terms in the same language for a given entry.
ekvivalenti: Column "LG": LG corresponds to the language in which an entry is completed. There is one line per term, even when there are several terms in the same language for a given entry.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: You can view the data in your language only (and possibly in other languages you are interested in) by applying a filter in the LG column as below: please click on the arrow in the LG column (blue box), then uncheck the "(Select All)" box checked by default, tick the desired language (or languages) and click on "OK".
ekvivalenti: You can view the data in your language only (and possibly in other languages you are interested in) by applying a filter in the LG column as below: please click on the arrow in the LG column (blue box), then uncheck the "(Select All)" box checked by default, tick the desired language (or languages) and click on "OK".

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: To remove a previously applied filter, simply click on the arrow in the column where the filter is located again and click on "Clear Filter From LG".
ekvivalenti: To remove a previously applied filter, simply click on the arrow in the column where the filter is located again and click on "Clear Filter From LG".

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: The collection "Rules of Procedure CJEU" (sheet: Rules_of_procedure) does not contain data in Gaelic (GA).
ekvivalenti: The collection "Rules of Procedure CJEU" (sheet: Rules_of_procedure) does not contain data in Gaelic (GA).

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: In the "National Courts and Tribunals" collection (sheet: National_Courts_Tribunals), the ISO codes in the "Origin" column refer to the legal system of the entry.
ekvivalenti: In the "National Courts and Tribunals" collection (sheet: National_Courts_Tribunals), the ISO codes in the "Origin" column refer to the legal system of the entry.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: "Term" column: you can search either in a specific sheet or in all sheets to find a specific term. Simply press Ctrl+F and, in the window that opens, enter the search term (case sensitive). By default, the search is carried out in the sheet you are in; to search the entire file, click on Options and select the "Workbook" option under "Within". To perform an exact match search of a term, please check the box "Match entire cell contents". Click on "Find All" to get the available results.
ekvivalenti: "Term" column: you can search either in a specific sheet or in all sheets to find a specific term. Simply press Ctrl+F and, in the window that opens, enter the search term (case sensitive). By default, the search is carried out in the sheet you are in; to search the entire file, click on Options and select the "Workbook" option under "Within". To perform an exact match search of a term, please check the box "Match entire cell contents". Click on "Find All" to get the available results.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: "Domain" column (sheet: Comparative_Legal_Vocabulary): you can filter the entries by subject field. For example, to view only the entries pertaining to a specific subject field (e.g. rights of aliens), click on the arrow in the Domain column, then on "Text Filters" and then on "Contains".
ekvivalenti: "Domain" column (sheet: Comparative_Legal_Vocabulary): you can filter the entries by subject field. For example, to view only the entries pertaining to a specific subject field (e.g. rights of aliens), click on the arrow in the Domain column, then on "Text Filters" and then on "Contains".

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: In the window that opens, enter the desired subject field next to the "contains" field, e.g. rights of aliens (case sensitive), then click OK.
ekvivalenti: In the window that opens, enter the desired subject field next to the "contains" field, e.g. rights of aliens (case sensitive), then click OK.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: To search for two domains, please click on the arrow in the Domain column, then on "Text Filters" and then on "Contains". In the window that opens, enter the first subject field you are looking for (e.g. rights of aliens), tick one of the two Boolean operators AND (to obtain entries pertaining simultaneously to both subject fields) or OR (to obtain entries pertaining to one of the two subject fields), click below on the arrow and choose the option "contains", and in the field on the right enter the second desired subject field (e.g. civil law). Then click on OK.
ekvivalenti: To search for two domains, please click on the arrow in the Domain column, then on "Text Filters" and then on "Contains". In the window that opens, enter the first subject field you are looking for (e.g. rights of aliens), tick one of the two Boolean operators AND (to obtain entries pertaining simultaneously to both subject fields) or OR (to obtain entries pertaining to one of the two subject fields), click below on the arrow and choose the option "contains", and in the field on the right enter the second desired subject field (e.g. civil law). Then click on OK.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Warning: if you apply filters, don't forget to remove them when you don't need them anymore, either by clicking on the arrow in the column heading where the filter is located and clicking on the option "Clear Filter From ...". (see above under "LG" column), or by clicking on the Data tab at the very top and, in the Sort & Filter section, on the Clear button (blue box below). This second option removes ALL filters.
ekvivalenti: Warning: if you apply filters, don't forget to remove them when you don't need them anymore, either by clicking on the arrow in the column heading where the filter is located and clicking on the option "Clear Filter From ...". (see above under "LG" column), or by clicking on the Data tab at the very top and, in the Sort & Filter section, on the Clear button (blue box below). This second option removes ALL filters.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Column 'LIFECYCLE': indicates whether a concept has become obsolete ('historical').
ekvivalenti: Column 'LIFECYCLE': indicates whether a concept has become obsolete ('historical').

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Column 'Systematic or ad hoc terminology work' (sheet: ComparativeLegalVocabulary): indicates whether an entry falls under subject-based or ad hoc terminology (see under "1-File content" above).
ekvivalenti: Column 'Systematic or ad hoc terminology work' (sheet: ComparativeLegalVocabulary): indicates whether an entry falls under subject-based or ad hoc terminology (see under "1-File content" above).

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Deprecated term: term whose use is not desired or which constitutes a common error.
ekvivalenti: Deprecated term: term whose use is not desired or which constitutes a common error.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Obsolete term: old form of a term or name.
ekvivalenti: Obsolete term: old form of a term or name.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Admited term: correct but non-preferred term.
ekvivalenti: Admited term: correct but non-preferred term.

zapisi.pojam_izvornik: Proposed term: provisional solution may be proposed when a designation has not yet been adopted.
ekvivalenti: Proposed term: provisional solution may be proposed when a designation has not yet been adopted.
